sources.title: ZeroGPU/zlm-v1-iab-domain-classifier · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model was trained on ~1 million domains whose IAB categories were labeled by a stronger teacher LLM that could see the live page (title and description) at labeling time. The model distills that page-aware knowledge into the URL string — at run time, from the URL alone, it reproduces judgments that normally require fetching the page.
